cycle.how: probe distribution with a higher cachebuster + codex plugin add
cycle.result: installed; previous cache dir removed by the manager

cycle.how: point the entry back at the canonical distribution + codex plugin add
cycle.result: older version reinstalled; integrity ok; npm ci re-run in the new cache

managerCleanup: Each add replaced the previous versioned cache directory, leaving exactly one installed copy.
